title: Arrival airport must be supplied
why: Verifies the arrival airport reference is mandatory and must resolve to an Airport.

steps.does: POST …/flight with otherwise valid data and ArriveAirportId set first to the empty guid, then to an unknown guid 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222

expect: Both rejected with an error on ArriveAirportId; nothing is saved.
